--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT BAC_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY BAC_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BAC_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT 
BAC_ID
,BAC_UUID
,BAC_CLT_ID
,BAC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
,BAC_BAT_ID
,BAC_BAT_ID
,BAC_CREATED_BY
,BAC_CREATED_TS
,BAC_UPDATED_BY
,BAC_UPDATED_TS
,BAC_STS_ID
,BAC_AUDIT_LOG
,BAC_CUR_ID
,BAC_INS_ID
,BAC_BRN_ID
,BAC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED
,BAC_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT BAC_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY BAC_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_WITH_DUP_20240321
